Hi Lina / BrightLeaf AP,

We're finishing vendor setup for BrightLeaf and want to align on the invoice intake path. Two quick questions so our AP mapping and PO-stamping logic are correct: 

1) Portal vs email: If we onboard you to our vendor portal, is that the preferred/required channel for production invoices? If you need to continue sending invoices by email (accounts-payable@...), can you confirm the required subject-line token format we should parse to auto-match PO numbers? Example we propose: "BLPO-<PO#>" or "PO:<PO#>".

2) Template / required fields: Please list the minimum required invoice fields (PO number, Redwood payer code, remit address, tax ID, line-level quantities/prices, invoice date). If you have a sample CSV or header mapping we can import into our AP pipeline, please attach.

I'm attaching our vendor onboarding form (stub) and a short mutual action plan draft — Marissa, can you review the onboarding checklist items for portal enablement? Karthik, can you advise if we can accept stamped PDFs as a fallback and still auto-extract the PO if the subject token is present?

Goal: avoid manual exceptions and get a test invoice through this week so we can verify PO-stamping and routing.

Thanks,

Sergio Alvarez

sergio@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: portal fallback subject token and PO-stamp guidance

Hi Sergio — thanks for the clear summary. 

Portal is our preferred channel (vendorportal.brightleaf.io). That said, we will continue to accept invoices via email to accounts-payable@brightleaf.io for the first 30 days after portal onboarding. When sending invoices by email, please use the subject token exactly as: BLPO-<PO#> (no spaces between BLPO and dash). Our parser looks for that prefix. Example subject we accept for auto-match: 

  "BLPO-123456 | Invoice 98765"

Minimum required fields for auto-accept (CSV / PDF line-level or header):
- PO number (must match BLPO token)
- Redwood payer code (field name: buyer_code)
- Invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- Line items: description, qty, unit_price, line_total
- Tax ID (vendor_tax_id)
- Remit address (remit_line1, city, state, postal_code, country)

I've attached a small sample CSV (sample_invoice.csv) with header names we can import. We also accept stamped PDFs, but to auto-insert the PO we need the BLPO token in the subject; otherwise we'll have to manually route it.

Attachments: sample_invoice.csv

One more note on PO-stamping: if you can include an additional field in the onboarding form for "Preferred remit method" and "Invoice format (CSV/PDF)" that helps our mapping team.

I'll open a DocuSign envelope with BrightLeaf's W9 and vendor setup docs — please sign, and once we confirm portal access we'll do a 1-hour walk-through to validate automatic PO matching. SLA once portal live: 7 business days processing for first invoices.

Best,
Lina Torres
AP Operations Manager | BrightLeaf Networks
lina@brightleaf.io

- We will accept stamped PDF as fallback, but will need the token in the subject for auto-route.

If BrightLeaf can go ahead and send the test files, Lina — we'll expedite the first reconciliation and close the loop. I'll also sign the DocuSign when it arrives.
